description: Host-conforming floor slab. Attach to a SPACE (from Space Properties): the slab takes the space's polygon as its footprint — there are no plan-size parameters here. `thickness` extrudes the polygon downward from `level`, and `color` fills it in both the 2D plan and the 3D view. The `host` geometry rule extrudes the host (space) polygon as a single slab from `level - thickness` to `level`, so the renderer needs no per-object code.

cases._doc: One slab = the host space polygon extruded from (level - thickness) up to level.
